scope: Prime31 Dickson quotient component; no solver complexity advantage or full ECDLP claim
statement: For a smooth short-Weierstrass curve in characteristic greater than three and a rational target R=(r,s) with s nonzero, the homogeneous Dickson trace/norm recurrence computes Res_Y(D_(2^k)(Y)-c,S3(X,Y,r)), including specialization at X=r. Rational S3 solutions lift and recover signed P+Q=R by the centered-line formula. This is an unsigned written argument with native identity checks, not Lean or signed PCC verification.
